title: CAMPUS CREWNECK
description:
This is the full length version of our popular Campus Crop Crew. It is actually an edit of the very first crewneck we released in 2017 (fussy pattern work and lots of top stitching and pockets - an FDN classic!).

  • 5 thread serge & topstitched seams - for durability and longevity.
  • Full rib gusset along arms and side body for breathability.
  • Flatlock arm seams - for bulk reduction and smoother finish inside and out.

title: SLEEP SHORTS
description:
The Sleep Shorts were developed as a lightweight short that you could barely feel on you, with a raw hem and flatlocked seams, and an ultra-comfortable rib waistband with very soft elastic. They're perfect for sleeping in, hanging around the house or cottage. 

The raw hem will simply curl up as you wear the shorts in. It will not fray.

Features

  • Flat locked seams for comfort
  • Ultra comfortable 3" wide Lycra/cotton waistband with 2" wide soft knitted elastic
  • Raw hem

Designed, cut and sewn in our factory in Oshawa Ontario.

Fit Notes

Dimensionally, the Sleep Shorts fit the same as the Short Shorts, so you can just select the same size you would normally be. Because the waistband is so soft and comfortable, and the absence of hems, pockets and detailing, they do feel much roomier than the Short Shorts. If you think you're between sizes, you could select a size down. To maximize comfort, select your regular size.

title: OSHAWA VINTAGE CAR PRINTED T-SHIRT
description:
This is the first printed shirt we have ever released! The original photo for this artwork was taken by Duey in 2018 of a car parts factory in the south end of Oshawa. This factory has been in operation since 1947. In a stoke of luck, a beautiful vintage muscle car, the 1971 Oldsmobile 4-4-2, drove by and Duey caught it in the shot. The 4-4-2 was built at the GM Oshawa Car Assembly during the 1960s-70s, and the parts for that car likely came from the plant in the background. 

Our Classic T-Shirt is made from an ultrasoft mid-weight 100% cotton jersey which is knitted right here in Ontario. Featuring flat seams and classic lines, this t-shirt is your new staple. The fit on the body is classic, length to just past the hip with a great drape that doesn't cling.

Features

  • Screenprinted by hand in our shop with print from original Oshawa street photo taken by Duey
  • Flatlock side seams and under arms.
  • FDN logo woven tab on left side hem.
  • 1" rib collar

Designed, cut and sewn in our factory in Oshawa Ontario

Model & Fit Info 

Ruby is wearing a size Small on the beach. Please see garment size chart above. To see t-shirt on more models, please see photos on our Classic T-Shirt product page.

title: Children's Hoodie
description:
Our children's hoodie has been designed for maximum coziness, comfort and longevity. The hoodie features flatlocked seams and a top stitched collar for ultimate comfort on the inside. Our fabric is lightly brushed inside for a super soft feel. It is designed long and tall in order to fit children over 2 years of growth. The 4" wrist cuffs cuffs can be worn rolled back or fully extended to cover more stages of growth. 

Features

  • Flatlocked sides seams, arms and shoulders, for bulk reduction and smoother finish.
  • Long body & arms for maximum growth accommodation
  • Top stitched collar and shoulders for comfort around the neck
  • Designed, cut and sewn in our factory in Oshawa Ontario.
  • Arm cuffs can be folded back or unrolled to accommodate growth

Fit Notes

The children's hoodies fit long in the body and in the sleeves. The body of the hoodie is a relaxed fit and generally it is not needed to go a size up, even if your child is bigger than average. Please refer to the size chart and compare to your child's arm length and torso length.

title: Children's Pants
description:
Our children's pants feature flatlocked seams and a top stitched waistband for ultimate comfort on the inside. Front pockets are top stitched onto the front leg, so that there are no extra seams inside. Made of pre-shrunk 100% cotton French terry, these pants are cozy and warm. A high waisted design, with a sturdy but soft 2" wide elastic that keeps the pants on and the lower back protected. The cuffs are extra long and can be folded back or rolled out to accommodate growth.

Features

  • Flatlocked inner leg seams for bulk reduction and smoother finish.
  • 2" sturdy but soft elastic, tacked to prevent folding.
  • Top stitched waistband and side seams for maximum comfort
  • 100% cotton Canadian-made French terry fabric, pre-shrunk.
  • Adjustable cuffs (2+ inches) to accommodate growth

 Designed, cut and sewn in our factory in Oshawa Ontario.

Fit Notes

The pants are sized in 2 year increments and designed to fit the upper year perfectly, but be a bit big for the lower year. For example, the size 3-4Y pant is made to fit a four year old in their entire 5th year of growth (i.e. the entire time they're 4 years old). They will be a bit big on a 3 year old, but will stay on at the hips and need to be worn with the cuff rolled up.

Please refer to the size chart and compare to your child's leg length and waist measurements.

title: CUSTOM FIT & COLOUR
description:
At FRÈRE DU NORD all of our manufacturing and patternmaking is done in house, which makes it possible for us to do tailoring for our customers that don't fit into our production size range. We have the technical capability to tailor any of our pieces to make them fit you.

We can do a lot of small changes for free, but for a full garment production pattern change, we charge a $30 cutting fee on top of the regular cost, since the garment has to be cut individually. If you order multiples of the garment, the cutting fee only applies once.

Since all of our pattern making is done digitally, we store your custom pattern files and you can re-order any time.

You can also get our garments colour blocked in any combination of our in-stock fabrics. Please use the form below to book a fitting appointment with us, or to enquire about custom colour combinations.

We are open Monday - Friday 10:00 AM- 5:00 PM and Saturdays 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM.
